subject.title: fix(gateway): count pending restarts toward maxRestartsPerHour budget

question: Should `gateway.channelMaxRestartsPerHour` remain a strict ceiling on channel-manager calls, or may an already-admitted pending recovery receive one unrecorded completion call at the cap?
rationale: Both open implementations deliberately exceed the documented maximum by one call to preserve stop-timeout recovery, and source/tests cannot determine whether that compatibility tradeoff matches the intended operator contract.

options.title: Allow one bounded completion call
options.body: Accept the proposed `max + 1` pending-recovery behavior after the contract is clarified and real adapter proof confirms the continuation is necessary and bounded.

options.title: Preserve a strict call ceiling
options.body: Refactor accounting so pending recovery completes within the configured maximum, likely by budgeting recovery cycles rather than adding an unrecorded call.

options.title: Pause both overlapping PRs
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while a gateway owner defines the restart-budget invariant, then retain only the implementation matching that invariant.

recommendation.title: Allow one bounded completion call
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed `max + 1` pending-recovery behavior after the contract is clarified and real adapter proof confirms the continuation is necessary and bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the configurable restart-budget surface whose precise meaning is now in question.
